retained_key_names: Historical resource_caps_proposal and digest_proposal keys are retained for interface compatibility; their contents are frozen rules, not pending choices.
authority: Only accepted source-close cleaned ROI series define participant metrics and downstream statistics. Raw/GS arrays, CSV measurements, metadata diagnostics and JSON endpoints are receipts, not alternate inputs.

common_rules.failure_marker: failure_report.json is authoritative if it lexists, even as a broken symlink or alongside otherwise valid artifacts. Check before and after validation.
common_rules.success: Exactly the five required named regular artifacts must exist. Harmless bounded regular extra files/fields are allowed; none supplies scientific authority.
common_rules.paths: No symlinks, devices, FIFOs, path escapes or duplicate normalized paths. Output must be disjoint from source/code inputs; creation may use a fresh absent or real empty output directory, never overwrite source or stale evidence.
common_rules.json: UTF-8; reject duplicate keys and NaN/Infinity literals; JSON numbers must be actual finite numbers, not strings or Booleans. Undefined required numbers use null only.
common_rules.csv: UTF-8, unique nonempty column names, exactly one row per required key. Numeric scientific notation is allowed. Blank string is the only undefined numeric token; do not use NaN, infinity, None or fabricated zero.
common_rules.ids: Literal exact strings; no numeric aliases, stripped prefixes, zero padding repairs or fuzzy ID matching.
common_rules.integers: Required array integer axes may use finite exactly integral numeric values, not Boolean dtype; scalar JSON integer fields require actual non-Boolean integers. Counts cannot be negative.
common_rules.booleans: Required Boolean NPZ arrays have Boolean dtype. Required JSON Boolean fields have actual Boolean type.
common_rules.permutations: Accept coherent participant, frame, ROI, pipeline, CSV column/row, keyed JSON record and source-file permutations. Original ordered documentary headers and source-frame numbers retain their literal meanings.
common_rules.extras: Required scientific fields are always validated. Optional descriptive strings and finite extra numeric arrays/fields within published caps are not a prose or algorithm gate.
common_rules.no_scoring_qa_closure: Production scores one source-bound validation of the submitted artifacts. Mutation/equivalence authoring tests are not additional acceptance requirements on arbitrary near-boundary valid submissions.

resource_caps_proposal.status: Frozen pre-BOLD bounds, unchanged after confirmation of the 26,040-frame structural dimensions.
resource_caps_proposal.npz_types: Boolean, signed/unsigned integer, finite real floating point, fixed-width Unicode/bytes only; no object, pickle, complex, structured dtype or repeated ZIP members.

subject_ids.semantics: Exact fixed 155 literal IDs; axis for canonical_active only.

roi_ids.semantics: Exact twelve method ROI IDs; axis for raw_roi, cleaned_roi and canonical_active.

pipeline_ids.semantics: Exact without_GSR and with_GSR; axis for cleaned_roi and canonical_active.

frame_subject_ids.semantics: Literal subject of each frame row; repeats expected.

frame_indices.semantics: Zero-based original released frame index; (frame_subject_ids,frame_indices) is an exact complete unique key.

raw_roi.semantics: Source-bound scaled voxel means before temporal cleaning, in original source signal units; receipt only.

global_signal.semantics: Source-bound mean of individually detrended GS-mask voxel series; receipt only, never nuisance-design authority.

cleaned_roi.semantics: Accepted canonical-support source-close clean primitive; all participant and group measurements replay from this array.

canonical_active.semantics: Exact source-defined pre-standardization activity mask, not rethresholded accepted values or submitted diagnostics.

signal_evidence.npz.comparison: Pointwise raw/GS and clean tolerances from method; additionally compare centered active clean directions within each subject/arm/ROI at relative L2 <= 1e-6 without an absolute floor.
signal_evidence.npz.inactive: Canonical clean sentinel is zero; finite submitted inactive entries within source pointwise tolerance are permitted but ignored. They never create a defined edge.
signal_evidence.npz.keying: Reorder all axes coherently to canonical literal IDs and source frame order before any arithmetic. Do not depend on archive member or row order.

source_fields.age: finite source Age, no inferred adult cutoff
source_fields.mean_fd: finite observed-entry source FD mean before fill; receipt only

network_connectivity.csv.metrics: Required metric values in [-1,1] equal own unrounded accepted-clean replay within derived scalar tolerance; blank iff replay is undefined.
network_connectivity.csv.null_pattern: status ok iff finite metric; otherwise blank. Every participant remains present.
network_connectivity.csv.precision: Six-decimal derived metric receipts may be accepted when within declared tolerance. They must never be read back as inputs to ranks or adult means.

required_top_level.adult_means: dict exact four metric keys -> finite [-1,1] or null
required_top_level.adult_support: dict exact four metric keys -> adult_support_record

child_metric_record.types: r/p and motion_adjusted r/p are finite numbers or null; n_expected,n_defined,df,nuisance_rank and adjusted_df are exact non-Boolean integers; statuses strings.
child_metric_record.patterns: ok -> both r,p finite; perfect_correlation -> abs(r)=1,p=0; all other statuses -> corresponding r,p both null. Ordinary and motion-adjusted statuses may differ; support counts describe the same complete participant slots.
child_metric_record.rank_authority: Ranks are computed from unrounded accepted-clean-derived values, not CSV numbers. FD/age covariates are canonical source values. No hidden source r/p or canonical outcome-rank target.

adult_support_record.patterns: ok requires all33 values defined and adult mean finite; otherwise mean null. A constant complete adult group is valid.

age_effects.json.comparison: Own replay under method-derived scalar tolerance plus exact discrete support/status/null checks. Complete refers to completed processing, not a forced finite endpoint.

required_top_level.reporting_kernel_sha256: frozen exact SHA256 of the disclosed byte-identical public/private reporting kernel
required_top_level.analysis_scope: nonempty descriptive string; no exact prose fingerprint
required_top_level.roi_definitions: 12 records keyed by literal roi_id, exact network/radius/center
required_top_level.source_files: complete 330-member final manifest identity list keyed by relative path; total source bytes 942572457
required_top_level.software_versions: dict of actual nonempty version strings for python,numpy,scipy,nibabel,nilearn,scikit_learn; not a version acceptance fingerprint
required_top_level.warnings: list of strings, possibly empty; no forced warning count

cohort_record.authority: Exact original joins and missing-index support; numeric age/FD receipts source-bound. All 168 original FD entries per subject are observed, including the first frame: observed count 168 and missing-frame list empty.

source_file_record.authority: Complete exact final inventory; subject_id literal or null for shared documents/template. Additional upstream identity fields are allowed.

source_observed_record.participants_column_names: Original ordered table header, exact source strings.
source_observed_record.frame_alignment: nonempty descriptive statement preserving original released frame order and explicitly not asserting measured movie onset; no exact prose gate
source_observed_record.template: record with path,sha256,header and normalization; exact source/method receipts. Preserve raw unknown units; the millimeter convention is documentary, not a rewritten header.
source_observed_record.persons: 155 records keyed subject_id, each requiring bold_path,confounds_path,bold_header,frame_count,confound_column_names,selected_confound_columns,excluded_confound_columns,missing_selected_entries,mean_fd_sum,mean_fd_observed_count,roi_supports,global_support. Original column-name order and frame indices remain exact. Each frame_count is 168; each original header and participant-specific scaling pair must be preserved.

bold_or_template_header.numeric_policy: Finite numeric metadata under method header tolerance; only raw documentary nonfinite header values use literal strings NaN,+Inf,-Inf, never scientific-array nonfinite values. BOLD raw spatial/temporal units remain unknown and fourth zoom remains 1; do not replace them by mm/sec or the separately documented 2-second TR. Per-participant original slope/intercept values are not assumed equal.
bold_or_template_header.dtype_policy: Accept semantic NumPy dtype equality for this explicit storage_dtype field, including legitimate aliases; reject wrong kind,width,byteorder,structured or object types. No arbitrary key-name-based normalization.

run_metadata.json.missing_selected_entries: List keyed by (frame_index,column_name), retaining any original missing token and applied value; exact source membership. The authenticated frozen source has no missing selected entry, so this list is empty for every participant and no fill is applied.

support_record.roi_supports: 12 records also containing roi_id; exact keyed membership.
support_record.digest_proposal: SHA256(b'SOCIALBRAIN_support_v2\n' + source_shape3 as little-endian int64 + selected_affine4x4 as C-order little-endian float64 with signed zeros normalized + ascending C-flat voxel indices as little-endian int64). Same rule for GS support.
support_record.status: Frozen grid-inclusive digest encoding and keyed vocabulary, qualified by exact independent/oracle geometry comparison before BOLD values.

analysis_observed_record.persons: 155 records keyed subject_id; each has pipelines list keyed pipeline_id, each requiring cleaning_rank,roi_activity records keyed roi_id and n_active_rois.
analysis_observed_record.roi_activity: roi_id,raw_centered_l2,residual_centered_l2,activity_threshold,active. Scalars are diagnostic receipts, active is exact canonical Boolean; never rethreshold diagnostics.
analysis_observed_record.scope: No canonical source age r,p,adult mean or hidden endpoint is required in metadata.

run_metadata.json.extra_keys: Harmless descriptive additions accepted at object levels; declared literal-ID dictionaries/lists must retain exact required membership.

findings.md.requirement: Nonempty UTF-8 text within cap. No keyword, stance, sign, significance or difficulty gate.
findings.md.expected_human_scope: Describe measured two-arm results and missingness/support with the method's cross-sectional, shared-movie, GSR and paper-adaptation limits. This expectation is not a prose-score classifier.

failure.execution: Any source identity/shape/geometry/missingness precondition failure exits nonzero and preserves an authoritative failure_report.json in an eligible owned output directory. Never create a failure marker inside source/code/document inputs.
failure.statistics: A scientifically undefined participant/group endpoint is not an execution failure: keep all identities and explicit null/status/support records.
failure.no_fallback: No download in grading, bank fallback, copied cohort endpoint, substituted template, dropped person or invented zero endpoint.
